items.source: Resolve the supplied request and request path to a Resource that exists under one of the given resource locations.
items.translation: 将提供的请求和请求路径解析为存在于给定资源位置之一的Resource。

items.source: locations - the locations to search in when looking up resources
items.translation: locations - 查找资源时要在其中搜索的位置

items.source: Provides mechanisms for resolving an incoming request to an actual Resource and for obtaining the public URL path that clients should use when requesting the resource.
items.translation: 提供将传入请求解析为实际 `Resource` 的机制，并获取客户端在请求资源时应使用的公共 URL 路径。

items.source: This is useful when rendering URL links to clients.
items.translation: 这在向客户端渲染 URL 链接时非常有用。

items.source: Resolve the externally facing public URL path for clients to use to access the resource that is located at the given internal resource path.
items.translation: 解析客户端用于访问位于给定内部资源路径的资源的面向外部公共URL 路径。

items.source: request - the current request (may not be present in some calls)
items.translation: request - 当前请求（在某些调用中可能不存在）

items.source: requestPath - the portion of the request path to use
items.translation: requestPath - 要使用的请求路径部分

items.source: chain - the chain of remaining resolvers to delegate to
items.translation: chain - 要委托的剩余解析器链

items.source: the resolved resource, or null if unresolved
items.translation: 已解析的资源，或未解析时为null

items.source: chain - the chain of resolvers to delegate to
the resolved public URL path, or null if unresolved
items.translation: 解析后的公共 URL 路径，或者如果未解析则为null。

items.source: Jeremy Grelle, Rossen Stoyanchev, Sam Brannen
items.translation: Jeremy Grelle, Rossen Stoyanchev, Sam Brannen
